text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — high level action list for streaming/chat endpoint reliability (timeouts / partial responses / reconnect logic). Posting owners + rough timelines so we can track in the PM board.

elaine: TL;DR: recurring partial-response spikes and client reconnect flaps. Root causes: (a) client backoff not differentiating transient vs terminal, (b) missing streaming telemetry and traces, (c) some loadbalancer idle timeout interactions.

elaine: Proposed action items: 1) SDK reconnect/backoff change (client-side): exponentiate jitter + classify errors; 2) Server-side grace window on final chunk to reduce false partials; 3) Observability: full streaming spans + metric stream.partial_count + trace id propagation; 4) Infra: confirm LB keepalive / idle timeout alignment; 5) Run small-batch A/B with new reconnect policy for 2 weeks, monitor partial rate.

matt: taking item 1 (SDK reconnect/backoff). plan: add error classifier + exponential jitter up to 8s, limit retries to 6 for stream endpoints. will open PR by EOD tomorrow.

sri: taking 2 and will plumb a server-side "final-chunk grace" of 250ms where we await trailing frames before marking session as partial. need to validate memory impact. aiming for prototype in 3d.

julia: observability is me. will add new histogram metric `stream.response_completion_ms`, counter `stream.partial_count`, and tag `reconnect_reason`. also add streaming span (parent + chunk-level children). ETA: next sprint start (Mon).

henry: infra will validate LB idle timeout. current NLB idle is 350s? iirc. we want to ensure keepalive < backend idle; will run alignment tests and post results. assigning to infra-oncall this week.

zack: i'll update the postmortem and the runbook (playbook) with explicit triage steps and owner rotation for streaming incidents. include checklist: collect last-100 chunk timestamps, client SDK version, reconnect count. ETA end of week.

elaine: ops-bot can you create the tickets and link here? also add recurrence check every 2 weeks for next 2 months.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-3342 (SDK reconnect/backoff) -> assignee: matt, due: 3 days. Ticket created: INF-3343 (server final-chunk grace) -> assignee: sri, due: 4 days. Ticket created: INF-3344 (streaming telemetry) -> assignee: julia, due: 8 days. Ticket created: INF-3345 (LB idle alignment) -> assignee: henry, due: 5 days. Ticket created: INF-3346 (postmortem docs) -> assignee: zack, due: 7 days. Recurrence: biweekly follow-up reminders created for 8 weeks.

matt: quick note on implementation: will add classifier like: `if status in (ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT) and http_status==499 then transient = true else terminal = false` — also adding jittered backoff pseudocode in PR.

matt: pseudocode snippet:
```
backoff = min(8000, base * 2**attempt)
backoff = backoff * (0.5 + rand()) // jitter
if error in transient_list: retry()
else: surface_error()
```

sri: for server grace: approach is to buffer final chunk flags for 250ms and wait for trailing frames; if nothing arrives, mark partial. will add config flag `stream.final_grace_ms`.

julia: observability ask: please include trace-id in client reconnect header `x-rdinference-trace` so we can stitch spans. matt can you add header in SDK?

matt: yep, will propagate `x-rdinference-trace` in next SDK change.

henry: infra test plan: 1) baseline traffic for 24h; 2) apply keepalive adjustments on canary; 3) synthetic reconnect flood to verify no increased partials. will post dashboard link.

zack: will schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review early telemetry. please add your blockers now.

elaine: blockers: - memory impact for server buffering (sri), - need SDK roll in mobile (matt) - trace propagation on some proxies (henry). call out any other blockers.

sri: memory note: config will be opt-in (disabled by default) until we validate. memory overhead expected < 2% on typical streams but will load test.

matt: mobile SDK: will need engineering review — possibly ship server-side retry gating first then mobile patch. mobile timeline dependent on apps team.

henry: proxy that terminates TLS in certain partner region strips `x-` headers; i'll open infra ticket to ensure trace header preserved by NLB/proxies.

elaine: nice. Can everyone paste short status in INF ticket comments so PM/CS sees progress? we'll reconvene in 2 weeks.

zack: added a checklist to INF-3346 and linked RFC.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync on 1750009600 (two weeks).

julia: one more item — add alert: `stream.partial_rate > 0.5% for 10m` with page to oncall. propose severity P2.

elaine: agreed. julia please add alert and ping oncall.

henry: putting canary window on schedule Thu 10:00-12:00 PT.

matt: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 — includes classifier + trace header. requesting review from sri/julia.

sri: will review PR today.

zack: thanks team — putting these items on the remediation board now and will monitor. :thumbsup:
